decisions.statement: A keychain item outside the shared access group is unreadable by the widget extension.
A device with its secret in the pinned domain mints no secret.
A device with its secret only in the default domain mints one.
A device that did not say which domain has its secret mints a secret.
A device that could not be asked mints a secret.
The route answered here judges the credential alone.
A store that did not answer is read as no answer rather than as a refusal.
A device the route refuses lets go of its secret.
A device that let go of its secret mints another secret.
A device the route admits keeps the secret that device has.
A device the route left unanswered keeps the secret that device has.
A device presenting nothing to the route is read as refused.
A device recovers once in a day and no more often.
A recovery mark later than now is read as no mark.
The keychain is emptied before the mint rather than after the mint.
The plaintext secret is never handed back out of the keychain.
How often a device recovered is written nowhere.
Nothing here reaches the keychain or the route.

definition: whether a device mints a secret or keeps the one it has
